preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 10^6 inclusive.
The maximum weight of an edge m must be between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
Vertex a must be between 1 and n inclusive.
Vertex b must be between 1 and n inclusive.
Vertices a and b must be distinct.

postconditions.description: The number of beautiful trees modulo 10^9 + 7 must be a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7.
The return value must be the count of beautiful trees modulo 10^9 + 7, where a beautiful tree is defined as a tree where the distance between vertices a and b is exactly m.
